hypothesis: The frozen D017 Momentum mechanism may generalize after realistic spread and commission costs beyond EURUSD and GBPUSD without symbol-specific tuning.
model: Every tick based on real ticks (MT5 Model=4)

cost_model.spread: historical bid/ask embedded in each imported tick
cost_model.commission: 2.50 USD per lot per side for FX and XAU, applied/verified in post-test net-cost analysis where MT5 custom-symbol reports omit it
cost_model.slippage: no additional slippage; limitation reported separately
cost_model.contract_specs: read-only FundedNext demo symbol_info snapshot on 2026-09-01 before import

frozen_invariants: minimum auto-trade risk 0.25% of reference capital; scaled signals below floor are blocked

screen_criteria_per_market.data_quality: 100% real ticks and no timestamps at or after 2026-06-28
screen_criteria_per_market.positive_calendar_windows: >= 6 of 10 anchored monthly windows when all windows are covered

portfolio_gate: No automatic OOS. After all six one-shot runs, assess PnL/return correlation, overlapping USD exposure and simultaneous drawdowns; freeze any OOS qualifiers before opening OOS.
trial_family: one frozen generalization run per market
known_limitations: Current FundedNext contract/swap snapshot is used; historical financing schedules may differ.
Cross-currency tick values can vary with conversion rates and must be verified in each tester report.
No extra slippage stress is included in the first screen.
